text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT P2 — multiple prod deploys failing due to package fetch errors from GitHub Packages. PagerDuty pinging oncall.
jamie: oncall here, getting alerts that our hotfix deploys are failing during artifact install step. Customer-facing issue for Acme is still open, need hotfix out.
ara: looking at build logs now, CI runners show 503s from github.pkg.github.com when trying to npm install private packages.
miguel: same from infra side — runner hosts can reach github.com but package endpoints return 503. curl output:```curl -i https://npm.pkg.github.com/<org>/<pkg>/dist -H "Authorization: token ***"
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 15:23:01 GMT
Content-Type: application/json
{ "message": "Service Unavailable" }
```
lina: Acme CSM here — they have a critical patch waiting; they're asking for ETA. We need to triage dependency on GH packages.
ryan: security note — we use a deploy PAT on self-hosted runners for package access; flooding/ throttling could be token rate limit. Need to confirm if it's global GH outage or scoped to package registry.
ara: dug into runner logs, GHA action attempts to pull private packages as part of build matrix; actions show: `npm ERR! code E503` and `npm ERR! registry request to https://npm.pkg.github.com/.. failed, status 503`.
jamie: any quick mitigation to unblock hotfix? Can we pull prebuilt artifacts from our internal mirror or switch to a different registry temporarily?
miguel: internal artifact mirror (artifactstore.internal) has last night's build. We can repoint deploy pipeline to use that image if artifact present. But the build step for the hotfix itself requires running tests that need fresh package. Alternative: create a minimal patch image locally and push to docker.artifacts.redwood, then trigger manual deploy.
ara: I can try a manual build on a dedicated runner with the token rotated to a backup PAT (less likely to be rate-limited). If GH is having a global service issue this won't help.
jamie: open a ticket with GitHub if not already. Anyone seen GH status?
ryan: https://www.githubstatus.com/incidents listed a Packages degradation starting ~15:10 UTC. Posting ticket now.
ara: attempting to kick a manual runner build with backup token now. Command I'm running:```export NPM_TOKEN=***BACKUP***
npm ci --registry=https://npm.pkg.github.com
```
deploy-bot: deploy pipeline `prod/hotfix` failed: step `install-deps` exited 1. See workflow https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/actions/runs/56789 for logs.
ara: manual build with backup token failed with same 503. So looks like GH packages endpoint is returning 503 globally for our org.
miguel: mitigation plan options: 1) pull last good docker image from internal registry and do a hotfix deploy without building (if patch can be applied via config). 2) Build locally, produce artifact and upload to our internal artifact server and trigger deploy. 3) If packages are small, vendor (check in) the needed package temporarily? 4) Wait for GH to resolve and coordinate priority with GH support.
jamie: quick decision — option 2 looks fastest and lowest risk. Who can build and push artifacts?
ara: I can build and push a minimal hotfix artifact to artifactstore.internal and open a deploy. Need sign-off from jamie.
lina: tell Acme we'll attempt a manual artifact deploy now, ETA 30–45m, I'll update them.
ryan: FYI security approves using build machine with backup PAT for one-off artifact generation; rotate token after.
ajex: (typo) — sorry alex joining: taking handoff at 15:40 UTC. jamie handing to alex for on-call. jamie: handing off, summary pinned above. Alex please continue coordination, I'll monitor customer comms. :handshake:
alex: ack oncall takeover. ara, can you drop the artifact location and exact image tag when ready?
ara: building now — pushing to `artifactstore.internal/redwood/hotfix/acme-fix:20260303-01`. After push I'll trigger deploy job `manual/deploy-hotfix` and link the run.
depoy-bot: (typo) — deploy-bot confirms manual deploy job queued.
miguel: I'm standing by to promote the artifact through our canary lanes and watch metrics. Will hold rollback plan ready.
jamie: also opened GH support ticket #12345678 and added our logs + repro steps. Jira incident ticket INC-2026-045 opened and linked to Slack thread.
lina: updated Acme: "We're doing a manual artifact deploy using internal artifacts to get your hotfix out while GitHub Packages recovers. Expect 30–60 minutes."
ryan: after deploy, rotate any backup PATs used and record token usage. Add to incident timeline.
ara: image pushed and deploy triggered: https://deploy.redwood-internal/runs/90012. Install step skipped, using prebuilt image.
depoy-bot: manual deploy `manual/deploy-hotfix` succeeded in canary in 3m 12s. Promoting to prod now.
miguel: canary metrics look stable for 10m, CPU and p50 latency within normal. No error spike.
jamie: prod promotion complete. Acme confirmed fix applied. CSM Lina to close customer loop.
lina: confirmed with Acme, they're happy; will send post-incident note.
alex: filing postmortem action items: 1) add fallback to internal artifact use when package registry is degraded; 2) mirror critical private packages to artifactstore; 3) runbook update for GH packages outage; 4) token rotation procedure for emergency builds. Assigning owners in INC-2026-045.
ryan: also add automation to detect PKG 5xx and auto-failover to artifact mirror where possible.
jamie: thanks team. closing oncall handoff: alex remains oncall for remainder of shift. I'll join postmortem. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — resolved for our org via manual artifact workaround. GH status still indicates degraded service; monitoring continues.
